Name: Gold Clock Out House
Author: monteso
Description:
Lets be honest here. A giant pimped out gold clock in the middle of your farm is frankly unrealistic and immersion breaking. So I change it into
something one would find on a farm, especially one with no central
plumping. Yes, that ridiculous expensive building, is a out house.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW. STARDEWVALLEYMODS .NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE

[b][u]Disclaimer
[/u][/b]To remove the GoldClock hour hands from the Out House you must replace your Cursors file(included in V0.2). This will also affect the Community Center.

[u][b]Install Info
[/b][/u]Place gold clock.xnb into your StardewValley/Content/Buildings folder, and overwrite.

[u]Install info Content Patcher pack only

[/u][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download mod pack  and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
